name: Kudankulam Nuclear Power Project (KKNPP) units 1-6
status: U1-2 operating (2 x 1000 MW VVER-1000/V-412); U3-4 commissioning (first fuel delivered Dec-2025); U5-6 under construction (2021)
notes: Light-water VVER: needs enriched UO2 fuel (imported from Russia) but no heavy water.

name: Madras Atomic Power Station (MAPS), Kalpakkam
status: operating: 2 x 220 MW-class PHWR (205 MWe each in WNA reactor table; units critical 1983 & 1985)
notes: Natural-uranium PHWR, heavy-water moderated & cooled, seawater-cooled condensers. NOT under IAEA safeguards (India's 2006 separation plan), therefore fuelled only with domestic (UCIL) uranium.

status: first criticality 6 Apr 2026 (Wikipedia); not yet in commercial operation (DGR 0 MW)
loc_note: OSM node 6861924154 (power=generator); Wikipedia 12.55306,80.17333.
